description: This Java class 'ObbMountActivity' demonstrates managing an OBB file in an Android application, including mounting and unmounting OBB files with UI buttons and handling state changes.

classes.name: ObbMountActivity
classes.description: Main activity class for managing OBB files with UI buttons to mount/unmount and handling state changes.

classes.name: ObbState
classes.description: Inner class to retain the state of the OBB mount, including StorageManager, status, and path.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI, and retrieves or creates StorageManager and OBB path.

methods.name: onRetainNonConfigurationInstance
methods.description: Retains the current OBB state across configuration changes.
